scope: Any arbitrary q(b) with at most one distinct q>2^31, then one MAD/XOR/AND/OR on the nine initial words/q/root-only constants. The prefix of q is unrestricted. Fixed allowed raw root0x12345678.

certificate.scope: Y=G*e+DIV/REM/CDIV(C,P), arbitrary32-bit prepared G/C, arbitrary nonzero denominator P.

information_fibre.proof: All initial low9 are fixed. T-only prefixes/suffixes can distinguish points only through q low9. Thus q needs478 distinct low9 values. Floor has at most floor(MASK/D)+1 outputs; ceil at most ceil(MASK/D)+1; REM has at most floor(MASK/D)+1 low9 values because P low9 is fixed and P%D=P-D*k. SHR>=24 has at most256 outputs. These yield the stated exact integer bounds.

q_only_proof: A function of q/root constants equal to the full target permutation forces q to be a permutation. It would have2^31-1 distinct values above2^31, contradicting the one-high assumption.
scalar_q_proof: Even G fails the b16 low-bit pair. For odd G, q=G^-1*(Y-I); the fresh scanner exhausts every odd inverse and finds two distinct high q for every choice.
